name: claim
description: Claim a node before you work on it, and release it when done. A claim shows your presence on the canvas and tells other agents in a swarm to leave that branch alone. If another participant holds the claim you get a claimed error: pick a different node. Claims expire after ttl_minutes; claim again to renew. Claim frontier nodes one or a few at a time, not the whole map.

node_id.description: The node (and its subtree) to claim. Node id (nd_...) or an @ref you set earlier in this run.

note.description: What you are doing there, shown on hover.
